instructions: Classify the email into exactly one category.

criteria.ACTION_NEEDED: A non-job-search message that needs the reader to respond or act, such as replying, paying, scheduling or deciding.
criteria.JOB_CONFIRMATION: An automated acknowledgement that a job application was received.
criteria.JOB_REJECTION: A message that clearly declines a job application.
criteria.RECRUITER_REPLY: A real person at a recruiter or employer writing personally to the reader: replying, reaching out or arranging a call. Not an automated notice.
criteria.JOB_ALERT: An automated digest or alert listing job openings from a job board.
criteria.FYI: Informational mail that needs no action and is not junk, such as newsletters the reader follows, receipts and non-job confirmations.
criteria.IGNORE: Spam, promotions and low-value automated notifications.
